newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa off highs after NY inspired rise.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa off highs after NY inspired rise.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa firmed but ended the morning session off highs after a New York inspired rise, traders said.
Active May was last traded 12 stg higher at 868 stg, having seen a high of 871 stg after making a plus 10 stg opening call on May.
May volume was 695 lots of a total 2,453.
New York's strong performance Wednesday was foremost in traders' minds, one said.
Although New York saw fresh contract lows, May's recovery to end where it opened was viewed positively by the market, he said.
Volume, however was light, and bumped up by cross trades, he said.
Much of the demand in the market came from one big buyer, he said.
In fundamental news, cocoa arrivals at Ivorian ports ranged from 810,000 to 820,000 tonnes by February 10 against 880,000 tonnes in the record 1995/96 season, industry sources said.
